the inspiratory neurons of the ventrolateral medullary region of the cat were inhibited by thiopental, while the respiratory rhythm was unaffected, whereas cyanide caused a marked depression of the inspiratory neurons and a slowing of respiratory rhythm.

the inspiratory burst of activity of neurons in time ventral medullary region was prolonged and the number of spike discharge per burst increased in response to the intravenous injection of thiopental or cyanide.
